newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet slumps with IPE futures, premiums weak.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet slumps with IPE futures, premiums weak.

text.p: European jet prices were pulled lower by profit-taking on gas oil IPE futures, and spot premiums also came under pressure from abundant supply, traders said.
IPE Nov gas oil futures tumbled $13.75 to $224.50 per tonne and cargo premiums slipped a dollar to around $30 cif NWE.

"The Middle East is going to have to review its ideas about selling into Northwest Europe," a trader said, adding an arbitrage from the Gulf looked vulnerable if prices weakened further. About 70,000 tonnes was already fixed to sail through the Suez canal, he said.
